payload.body_they: Family and home can make power very practical for {{Name}}: who owns something, who pays, who has access, who is expected to help, and who gets the final say. They may also notice how old roles, obligations, silence, and past decisions keep shaping the present long after anyone remembers why the rule started. History can explain how the family got here without deciding that the same person must keep paying, helping, yielding, or carrying the responsibility now.
